body:
packages/simulation/parena_runtime.{h,c} grown from a 17-line stub to the full real PARENA runtime, vendored from PARENA/runtime/. New :editor mod (buffer+document+registry+note_version_mod compiled together) -- first mod crossing the host boundary with structs/Strings, not just I32. Verified no regression: bazel build/test //packages/simulation/... clean, all 14 tests pass. CLAUDE.md updated to document the real evolution and its real cost. Could not update this repo's own CHANGELOG.md -- owned by a different user (treeiii), ACL mask limits this session to read-only, same issue as BURROW earlier. PAPERCRAFT commit a12829a.

⚓ ☃
title: Evolved the PARENA mod boundary -- real struct/String mods (:editor)
